intervals.label: completed (last experiment ran until 2003/2006)
intervals.note: The collaboration's own start and end are not published in the sources read; its two named experiments ran 2000-2003 (NaIAD) and 2001-2006 (ZEPLIN-I/II, shared statement). The ZEPLIN-II/III work was carried out under the ZEPLIN Collaboration.
intervals.quote: The NAIAD experiment (NaI Advanced Detector) for WIMP dark matter searches at the Boulby Underground Laboratory (North Yorkshire, UK) ran from 2000 until 2003.

name: UK Dark Matter Collaboration (UKDMC)
notes: Whether the UKDMC and the 'Boulby Dark Matter Collaboration' named in astro-ph/0406126 are the same body is not stated in the sources read; no alias is claimed.

summary.plain: The British-led team that ran dark matter detectors in the Boulby mine in north-east England in the 2000s, including the NaIAD sodium-iodide array and the ZEPLIN-I liquid xenon detector.
summary.technical: UK Dark Matter Collaboration: operated NaIAD and ZEPLIN I at the Boulby Underground Laboratory (papers quote 'The UK Dark Matter Collaboration (UKDMC) has been operating various detectors for non-baryonic dark matter searches at the Boulby Underground Laboratory'). No formation date or roster is published in the sources read.
